entries.author: ANTONIUS MELISSA
entries.title: Index ad Antonii Melissae Locos communes
entries.note: Running head at 108077, title block 'INDEX AD ANTONII MELISSAE LOCOS COMMUNES' at 108109 on the same page 1333/1334; index of Latin headwords with sermon numbers.

problems: The Elenchus is headed 'Operum continuatio' (Eustathius's works continued from PG 135); the Ordo lists the Eustathius works WITHOUT columns except the first, so the Ordo could not cross-check them; every column confirmed from running heads and page numbers in the body.
Elenchus 'Sententiae ... 165' for Antonius Melissa read as 765 (body); De simulatione '313' read as 373 (body).

Parts for Melissa's Sententiae come from the Ordo, which the OCR scrambles badly: Pars I (Sermones I-LXXV) and Pars II (I-C) are interleaved with detached column numbers, so many ordoCol are empty and some read wrong (e.g. Sermo VII '191', several '8xx' values where Pars I runs ~765-1000). 167 of the expected 175 sermon heads were recovered (OCR roman numerals kept as read, some wrong, e.g. 'LIXI', 'XIV' for XXV); Pars I Sermones I-III supplied by hand without columns. Parts are unconfirmed in the body, as the brief directs.

Not entered (editorial, omitted by Elenchus): Notitia on Antonius Melissa (line 56607, col 765), 'Addenda Eustathii Epistolae' (line 107914, col 1331-1332), Monitum before the Epistolae (listed in note). Also not in Elenchus or Ordo: Euthymius Neopatrensis, Notitia and 'Laudatio funebris Eustathii' (lines 56052-56460, cols ~757-763), a work by another author inside the Eustathius/Melissa run.
Epistolae pages 1245-1332 body: Greek only by Migne's own Monitum.
Page 1245 for Epistolae rests on inference from 1243/1244 garbled numbers ('1913'/'1214') at line 101446 plus page spacing; OCR shows these numbers, not a plate read.
